department: School of Engineering — Department of Chemical and Biological Engineering (Bioengineering Program)

deadline.value: Fall 2027-28 non-local full-time deadline is June 1, 2027 (rolling admissions; local full-time deadline July 1, 2027; HKPFS deadline December 1, 2026).
deadline.quote: For 2027/28 Fall Term Intake (commencing in Sep 2027): | Non-local Applicants* | Full-time: 1 Jun 2027 | Local Applicants | Full-time: 1 Jul 2027 | Admissions is on rolling basis.

gre_subject.value: No ETS GRE Subject Test exists for bioengineering (ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics, and Psychology).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Bioengineering admission and 2027-28 catalog pages do not state a pre-application supervisor contact requirement.

funding.value: Full-time PhD students are eligible for HKUST Postgraduate Studentships (HK$229,620/yr, ~US$29,420/yr for up to 4 years), RedBird PhD Award, and HKPFS.
funding.quote: Postgraduate Studentship (PGS) | HK$229,620 per year (~US$29,420/ year) | Up to 4 years for full-time PhD students

entry_route.value: Admits bachelor's holders with first or second-class upper honours (4-year full-time PhD) and research master's holders (3-year full-time PhD).
entry_route.quote: hold a relevant Bachelor's degree with first or second class upper honours, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant Science or Engineering discipline from a recognized university; or | hold a Master's degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant Science or Engineering discipline from a recognized university which includes a research thesis.

also.quote: Full-time: 3 years (with a relevant research master’s degree), 4 years (without a relevant research master’s degree)

notes: Local Fall 2027-28 full-time deadline is listed as July 1, 2027 on prog-crs; offers optional Scientific Computation Concentration.
